entities.name: Sioux (Lakota/Dakota)
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The Lakota, Dakota, and Nakota peoples became the dominant power of the northern Great Plains after acquiring horses. Sun Dance ceremonies, tipi culture, and buffalo hunting defined their way of life. Sitting Bull and Crazy Horse became icons of resistance.
